scope: Data-only installation into the original P2 Mathlib selected-file namespace.
spec_compliance: FAIL: two corrections required before restoring the live root.

blocking_findings.title: The preflight does not establish absence of all destination entries and complete inventory coverage
blocking_findings.finding: destination_inventory records matching filenames only. A directory occupying a selected leaf or a non-directory parent in a missing path is not preflighted as a collision. os.walk also silently skips scandir errors by default, so an unreadable subtree cannot support a zero-extra-files claim. Existing receipts are tested with exists, which misses a dangling result symlink. In the latter case writes can complete before publication fails.
local_evidence: Two-file fixture, Z.olean already a directory: main created RESTORE_LAUNCH.json and A.olean, then raised FileExistsError at Z.olean.
Two-file fixture, existing dangling RESTORED.json: main created launch and both selected files before failing at result publication.

Control cases with an existing regular target, a prior regular launch, or an existing target symlink failed before writes. Failed verify left the fixture unchanged. The old guard bytes were unchanged in all six cases.
blocking_findings.minimum_fix: Before publishing launch, reject either existing receipt pathname using lexists/lstat, check all selected leaf names are genuinely absent and all existing parents are real directories, and propagate directory enumeration errors. Maintain the exact missing and zero-extra set comparison.
regressions: Occupied selected directory and dangling result must cause zero changes to any stage/runtime entry.
A stable non-directory parent or an enumeration error must abort before launch.

blocking_findings.title: Creates are not bound to the canonical directory checked immediately beforehand
blocking_findings.finding: Checking a pathname, then creating directories and opening that pathname again leaves a gap on the shared mutable runtime. xb prevents replacing an existing final entry, but does not constrain which directory an ancestor resolves to at create time. A concurrent ordinary directory replacement invalidates the earlier check. The restore must stop on root identity changes. No live race or path escape was attempted.
blocking_findings.minimum_fix: Anchor to an opened and identity-checked real runtime root. Traverse and create each component relative to directory descriptors with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW for descent; create leaves with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW relative to the established parent descriptor. Check root identity across the operation and before success, and anchor stage evidence separately. Preserve existing bytes on failure.
regressions: Use a small, controlled temporary-directory change between validation and creation. Require a stop and no file at an unrelated destination.
Exercise a preexisting leaf and a changed root identity using the descriptor-based create path.

verified_scope: Capsule and manifest pins, sizes, member count, selected record example, P2 snapshot identity, and P1 producer structure were cross-checked with TRANSFER_HEADER.json and producer source. The archive was still transferring locally; no full local acceptance is claimed.

The installer pins the whole capsule and embedded manifest, binds the snapshot rows to the original P2 logical inventory, and requires the exact ordered 24,923 selected path/record/file hashes totaling 7,156,488 bytes; it also requires the five evidence members and no other archive files.
The restore result is explicitly scoped to missing original bytes only. The guard and original snapshot are read and hashed. No Lean, kernel, or compatibility-acceptance command is present.
local_test_scope: Real main path and real local filesystem operations; only capsule decoding and payload selection replaced by a two-file fixture. No modification of installer code or original runtime. No cloud/Lean invocation.
disposition: Keep live restore unexecuted until the two fixes are independently reviewed. Runtime compatibility remains a separate decision.
